vcs_gitattributes.description: Location indicator for gitattributes files. 'none' disables maintenance. Other values enable it.

vcs_gitignore_mode.description: Mode for seeding .gitignore files. 'exact' seeds tracked files, 'recursive' descends directories, 'none' disables.

vcs_worktree_type.description: Interpretation of VCSH_BASE. 'absolute' uses absolute paths, 'relative' uses paths relative to GIT_DIR.

vcs_debug.description: Enable debug mode for verbose logging.

vcs_repo_d.description: Custom directory for storing vcsh repositories. Defaults to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/vcsh/repo.d.

vcs_hook_d.description: Custom directory for active hooks. Defaults to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/vcsh/hooks-enabled.

vcs_base.description: Custom base directory for checked out files. Defaults to $HOME.
